title: SREV-061 GDI printer retry device name contract

printer_device_name.description: CreateDCW pwszDevice/lpszDevice value identifying the printer

spooler_retry.description: OpenPrinter2W and DocumentProperties wake-up path before retrying CreateDCW

contracts: CreateDCW pwszDevice is the printer device name for printer DC creation
CreateDCW pdm is DEVMODE initialization data and is not a printer-name string
OpenPrinter2W pPrinterName must receive the printer or print-server name
DocumentProperties pDeviceName must receive the device name
The WINSPOOL retry path must require lpszDevice before opening the spooler object
